keyFindings.description: The README's 'Before and after across commits' (README.md:389-403) seeds with an older checkout's loadgen. Any checkout before this PR has no seed-refs, so `stack.sh seed --force` drops dispatch_seed, spends 14-27 min on loadgen seed, then dies on 'unknown command seed-refs' with no seed left. Fail fast before the drop when $BIN/loadgen lacks seed-refs, naming the cause, and say in the README how to measure a build older than this PR (seed with a loadgen that has seed-refs; this PR adds no migration).

TestMakeRefPlan says it pins the plan (README.md:330 'refs_test.go pins it') but checks only totals: replacing the citation draw with the last m elements of the permutation still passes (code-quality agent, go test -overlay). Pin the whole plan (e.g. a sha256 of every target's issue/versions/order and every source's citations).

callRetry retries a POST after a transport error with no Idempotency-Key, and POST /artifacts always writes version max+1, so a lost response adds a version; seed-refs then prints the plan's 19,471 whatever it wrote. Send an Idempotency-Key per (target, version), or check the ref_* counts against the plan and fail.
The worker pool is written twice (refs.go:256-292 and 305-344) and writeRefSources filters p.lga twice; use errgroup's SetLimit with one g.Go per item as seed.go:178-190 does.
refsFetch counts any non-empty-members body as 'with members', a 500 included, and prints a clean summary; count only 200s and print the number of other statuses.

refsShape keeps allRows and the authorBytes slice and re-sums them; refPct duplicates sample.go's pct/mkStat; refsGet (refs.go:498) duplicates api.call's headers; refAuthorBytes and refProdBytes hold one measurement twice.
'No step writes to those three projects' is false for steps above 400 sessions (run.go:374-380); same sentence in refs_test.go.
The note still says 18 to 27 min for loadgen seed; the README now says 14 to 27.

Round 2's wording item, now fixed in this PR since the file is touched: 'absent or all' -> 'absent, empty or all' in routes_table.go:96, references.go:246, cmd/dispatch/README.md and AGENTS.md rows, and the envoy pr2469-Added-20261028 fragment.
